tool.name: mOTUs_map_snv
tool.description: maps reads to the mOTUs database for downstream SNV calling
tool.command: @DATABASE_DIR_SETUP@ #if $input_type.input_type_selector == 'single': #set $reads = 'input_reads.' + $input_type.single_reads.ext ln -s '$input_type.single_reads' '$reads' && #else: #set $reads_fwd = 'input_reads_fwd.' + $input_type.forward_reads.ext #set $reads_rev = 'input_reads_rev.' + $input_type.reverse_reads.ext ln -s '$input_type.forward_reads' '$reads_fwd' && ln -s '$input_type.reverse_reads' '$reads_rev' && #end if motus map_tax -db '$DATABASE_DIR' -t \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} #if $input_type.input_type_selector == 'single': -s '$reads' #else: -f '$reads_fwd' -r '$reads_rev' $input_type.skip_pair_check #end if -l '$advanced_options.minimum_alignment_len' -o out.motus.bam && mv out.motus.bam '$output_bam'

param.name: skip_pair_check
param.label: Skip paired-read check
param.help: Do not verify that both read files contain the same read names. Useful if the mates are not sorted the same way or if one mate of a pair was removed.

param.name: db_source
param.label: mOTUs database source
param.option: Use a database from the history

validator.message: No compatible motus database is available

param.name: database_path
param.label: mOTUs database archive
param.help: The tar.gz archive of an mOTUs v4 marker gene database

param.name: minimum_alignment_len
param.label: Minimum alignment length
param.help: Reads shorter than this length are discarded. Should be adjusted to the average read length of your data.

tool.help:
# Map reads to the mOTUs marker gene database
Maps metagenomic reads against the mOTUs marker gene database with `bwa mem` and writes a read-name-sorted BAM file. In mOTUs v4 the mapping step is the `map_tax` command; it replaces the former `map_snv` subcommand.
Only alignments of at least 97% identity and the requested minimum alignment length are kept. For every read the best alignment is chosen and multimappers are distributed proportionally to the abundance of the uniquely mapped reads.
## Output
- **BAM file**: alignments of the reads against the mOTUs marker gene reference sequences, sorted by read name. It can be used for downstream single-nucleotide-variant (SNV) analyses.
